claims.quote: Boraras micros is a tiny cyprinid from the Mekong basin in northeastern Thailand, recorded in Nong Khai, Udon Thani and Sakon Nakhon provinces.
Mostly restricted to parts of the Mekong basin in northeastern Thailand where it's been collected in the provinces of Nong Khai, Udon Thani and Sakon Nakhon.
It's also said to occur in Laos but we've been unable to obtain any definitive information.
